description:
Open-source parametric 3D CAD built in Rust.

SolidCraft is an open-source parametric 3D CAD application built in pure Rust. Sketch, constrain, extrude, and change a parameter to watch the timeline rebuild. It runs on desktop and web, and can be automated through MCP with solidcraft-cli.
- Windows: updating no longer restarts the PC by itself. The in-app updater asks the installer not to restart, and the installer itself never restarts the computer, so updating from older versions is covered too.
- Why a patch: these two fixes and nothing else; the 0.48.0 notes list what's new in 0.48.
What's Changed
- Windows updater: prevent MSI from restarting the PC without consent (#18774) by @sylvesterkaczmarek in https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/pull/18775
- Windows installer: never restart the PC at the end of an install or update by @bherbruck in https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/pull/21453
Full Changelog: https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft/compare/v0.48.0...v0.48.1
